name: MELD: Multimodal EmotionLines Dataset
description: MELD (Multimodal EmotionLines Dataset) is an extension of EmotionLines for multimodal emotion recognition and sentiment analysis in conversations. Curated by Nanyang Technological University, it comprises 13,708 utterances across 1,433 dialogue segments from the TV series Friends, with each utterance annotated for emotion (Anger, Disgust, Sadness, Joy, Neutral, Surprise, Fear) and sentiment (Positive, Negative, Neutral) accompanied by synchronized audio and video clips.
